# WorldClockInvalidTimeMarkerError Class

> [!CAUTION]
> This class is still in pre-release.  Its signature may change or it may be removed in future releases.

## Extends
- *Error*

Error thrown when a time marker is invalid. This can occur when trying to access data on a time marker that has been removed.
